How to play
STICKSlide left or right to walk. Walking away is a little slower. JJump. Steer with the stick while you're in the air, and press P or K for a jump kick. AC can jump right over Brick to escape a corner. BHold to block. Blocked hits only chip a little health. SAMEPicking the same fighter as the CPU is fine: the CPU's copy wears different colors. SUPERFill the meter all the way (2.5 specials’ worth) without spending it and SUPER lights up. Supers can’t be blocked or jumped. P, KPunch and kick. Land a hit, then tap P or K again right away to chain a combo. SPECIALCosts 40 meter; the bar glows when it's ready. Jump or block the dumbbell, jump the quake, block the band (it reaches you even mid-jump), and jump Volt's Hyper Sprint (it can't be blocked).

Keyboard: left/right or A/D walk, up/W/space jump, J punch, K kick, L special, U super, I block, P pause.
